newsitem.title: USA: Stocks fall on weak technology sector; Greenspan effect.
newsitem.headline: Stocks fall on weak technology sector; Greenspan effect.

text.p: Stocks fell sharply Thursday as the market was hammered by a major sell-off in technology shares and leftover pressure from Wednesday's warning by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan over the market's lofty levels.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 58.11 points at 6,925.07, for a two-day loss of more than 100 points.
In the broader market, declining issues beat advances 2-1 on active volume of 468 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
